4 days ago · 🌐
The framework we teach: Prime, Prompt, Produce. Prime: Set up the AI with context who it is, what you need, what you know about the situation. Prompt: Ask the right question in the right way. Produce: Refine, iterate, get to the output you actually need. Most people skip the Prime step entirely. That's why their results are average. One extra minute of context = completely different output.

There are actually 4 types of AI. Most business owners only know about one. Enterprise AI: Custom-built for tech giants. Not for most of us. Embedded AI: Already inside your tools (SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft). Most people use this without knowing. Generative AI: Claude, Copilot, Gemini. Anyone with an internet connection can use it. This is where the magic is. AI Agents: Self-sustaining automation. Where early adopters are moving to now. Most businesses are sitting on a goldmine in the Generative AI layer and haven't tapped it yet. That's what we teach. How to actually use the tools you already have access to.
